business.name: Tarn Lake Cottage
business.tagline: A quiet two-bedroom cottage on the water, ten minutes from town.

services.name: Two bedrooms
services.description: A queen room and a twin room, both with lake views.

services.name: Private deck
services.description: Morning sun, a barbecue and the lake at the bottom of the garden.

services.name: Kayaks and bikes
services.description: Free to use during your stay.

about.story: Harbourstone started with one ute and a plate compactor in 2012. Today it is a crew of four, and the owner still measures every job and signs off every finish. Most of our work comes from neighbours of people we have already worked for.

reviews.quote: They turned a cracked, sloping drive into the best-looking entrance on the street, and finished a day early.
reviews.author: Karen W.

reviews.quote: Clear quote, no surprises, and the crew left the place tidier than they found it.
reviews.author: Mike T.

hero.alt: Lake with autumn trees reflected in still water
